project.description: Secure AI Gate - Chess Fair-Play: DevSecOps pipeline as a Freestyle job. Each "Execute shell" step is one security/quality gate; any failure stops the build and the image is NOT promoted.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: FAIL_ON_CVE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Fail the build if Trivy finds fixable HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: echo "==================== 1. Setup Python ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false python3 -m venv .venv $PY -m pip install --quiet --upgrade pip $PY -m pip install --quiet -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt rm -rf reports && mkdir -p reports git log -1 --oneline

echo "==================== 2. SAST - Bandit (fails on high-severity issues) ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false $PY -m bandit -r app -f json -o reports/bandit.json || true $PY -m bandit -r app -lll -iii

echo "==================== 3. Dependency scan - pip-audit (UNSTABLE on known CVEs) ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false $PY -m pip_audit -r requirements.txt -f json -o reports/pip-audit.json || exit 99

echo "==================== 4. Train AI model + Quality Gate ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false $PY -m app.train

echo "==================== 5. Unit, API-security and adversarial tests ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false $PY -m pytest tests --ignore=tests/selenium -v --junitxml=reports/junit-unit.xml

echo "==================== 6. Docker build ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false docker build -t $IMAGE:$IMAGE_TAG -t $IMAGE:latest . docker images $IMAGE

echo "==================== 7. Container scan - Trivy (UNSTABLE if scanner unavailable) ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false # Use the cached vulnerability DB (volume trivy-cache) so the scan runs offline in seconds if ! docker run --rm --entrypoint sh -v trivy-cache:/root/.cache/ aquasec/trivy:latest \ -c 'test -f /root/.cache/trivy/db/metadata.json'; then echo "Trivy vulnerability DB not cached yet - scan skipped" | tee reports/trivy.txt exit 99 fi # exit code 2 = HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs found; any other non-zero = scanner problem docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v trivy-cache:/root/.cache/ aquasec/trivy:latest \ image --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --skip-db-update --timeout 10m \ --exit-code 2 --no-progress $IMAGE:$IMAGE_TAG > reports/trivy.txt 2>&1 && STATUS=0 || STATUS=$? cat reports/trivy.txt if [ $STATUS -eq 2 ]; then if [ "$FAIL_ON_CVE" = "true" ]; then echo "Fixable HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs found"; exit 1; fi echo "CVEs found (reported, FAIL_ON_CVE=false)"; exit 0 fi [ $STATUS -eq 0 ] || exit 99

echo "==================== 8. Deploy to staging (docker compose) ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false docker network inspect ci-net >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create ci-net docker compose down --remove-orphans || true docker rm -f secure-ai-app selenium >/dev/null 2>&1 || true docker compose up -d for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf $APP_URL/health && break; echo "waiting for app..."; sleep 2; done curl -sf $APP_URL/health for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf $SELENIUM_URL/status | grep -Eq '"ready": ?true' && break; echo "waiting for selenium..."; sleep 2; done docker ps --filter network=ci-net

echo "==================== 9. UI tests - Selenium (watch live at http://localhost:7900) ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false $PY -m pytest tests/selenium -v --junitxml=reports/junit-ui.xml

echo "==================== 10. DAST - OWASP ZAP (UNSTABLE on findings) ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false docker rm -f zap >/dev/null 2>&1 || true docker run --name zap --network ci-net -u root zaproxy/zap-stable \ bash -c "mkdir -p /zap/wrk && zap-baseline.py -t $APP_URL -r zap-report.html -I" && STATUS=0 || STATUS=$? docker cp zap:/zap/wrk/zap-report.html reports/zap-report.html || true docker rm -f zap >/dev/null 2>&1 || true [ $STATUS -eq 0 ] || exit 99

echo "==================== 11. Promote image to :stable ====================" export IMAGE=secure-ai-gate IMAGE_TAG=$BUILD_NUMBER PY=.venv/bin/python export APP_URL=http://secure-ai-app:5000 SELENIUM_URL=http://selenium:4444 HEADLESS=false docker tag $IMAGE:$IMAGE_TAG $IMAGE:stable echo "Promoted $IMAGE:$IMAGE_TAG -> stable. All security gates passed."
